mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (-8112, -26620) and has to end up at (4378, 5278). On the way it must stop at A (Harbor UCLA Medical Center Interim West Heliport) at (240.7, -19083), B (Fox Plaza Helipad) at (-10442, 6137), C (Chase Plaza Heliport) at (3872, 4137), D (Los Angeles City Hall East Heliport) at (5355, 5904); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [Jack Northrop Field Hawthorne Municipal Airport (KHHR, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z2 [Los Angeles International Airport (KLAX, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [Santa Monica Municipal Airport (KSMO, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [Hollywood Burbank/Bob Hope Airport (KBUR, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z5 [Long Beach International Airport (KLGB, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z6 [Van Nuys Airport (KVNY, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 64192 meters. The battery only allows 67914 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Northrop Palos Verdes Heliport; DEST is International Jewelry Plaza Helipad.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
